study type: Retrospective cohort study (secondary analysis of survey data)
cohort: The study analysed data for 213,612 children from the National Family Health Survey (NFHS-5) in India.
finding: Children with a length of pregnancy less than 9 months had a 2.621 times greater hazard of under-five mortality compared to those with a gestational period of 9 months or more, with maternal age, haemoglobin, education, and household wealth also showing significant, often non-linear, associations.
gest_age: Less than 9 months, 9 months or more
